description: The tile realization of a media item. Same content contract as the immersive realization, recomposed for a grid — never redesigned for it.

MUST: Carry the same information and the same reading order as the immersive realization of the same item.
Hold one aspect ratio per grid, so the grid scans as rows rather than as a mosaic.
Render its text before its media decodes.
Keep the whole tile one hit target, with the primary action reachable without hitting a nested control.
SHOULD: State the count when the item carries more than one medium, without requiring interaction to discover it.
NEVER: Letterbox the media inside the tile.
Introduce a field the immersive realization does not have.
Reserve a slot for promoted or sponsored treatment.
